nina.p: Quick postmortem follow-up thread focused on vendor/dependency outage mitigations. We saw three recurring patterns: (1) cloud control-plane update delays that left LB config stale, (2) model-registry auth token churn causing transient 401/429s, and (3) external auth provider rate-limiting during mass rollouts. Need clear owners, timelines, and an operational checklist to prevent recurrence.

omar.s: I'll take the cloud control-plane mitigation. Plan: document a defensive deploy pattern (atomic LB updates + preflight canary) and build a daily synthetic that attempts a no-op control-plane update to detect slow convergence. Also evaluate using a global anycast edge for ingress to reduce reliance on single region LB updates. ETA: draft runbook + synthetic in 12 days, full rollout in 6 weeks. Creating INFRA-9001 now.

ben_r: I'll own model-registry resilience. Short-term: add a local manifest cache with TTL and a readonly fallback mode if auth fails. Also will add client-side token jitter + exponential backoff on 429s. Long-term: explore an async manifest replication path so workers can pull from a cached replica in our VPC. ETA cache + tests: 2026-04-12. Ticket: MLENG-3420.

taylor_ops: I'll lead vendor engagement and SLA remediation. Opening cases with cloud + auth provider, asking for 90-day telemetry and RCA. If providers can't show mitigations we should negotiate SLA credits and a runbook commitment. CASEs: CLOUD-10088, AUTH-10089. I'll post vendor timelines here. ETA vendor ask: today, first response by 2026-03-24.

oncall-bot: Incident ref: 2026-03-15-R3 attached: https://incidents.internal/2026-03-15-R3 (summary: auth 429 spikes coincident with rollout surge).

nina.p: Consolidated action items (please mirror into your trackers):
A) Defensive LB updates & synthetic convergence job 1 owner: omar.s 1 due: 2026-04-05
B) Registry manifest cache + readonly fallback 1 owner: ben_r 1 due: 2026-04-12
C) Registry client jittered token refresh + 429 backoff 1 owner: ben_r 1 due: 2026-04-18
D) Vendor SLA/RCA push + credits request 1 owner: taylor_ops 1 due: 2026-03-26
E) Add pre-rollout gating: auth 95p latency <200ms and 429 rate <0.5% in last 10m 1 owner: nina.p 1 start: immediate
F) Biweekly "dependency-patterns" retrospective 1 owner: nina.p 1 cadence: biweekly starting 2026-03-29

omar.s: Checklist I'll include in INFRA-9001 PR:
```
- Preflight: verify LB config dry-run in staging
- Apply atomic LB change with health-probe validation
- Post-deploy check: synthetic job must see control-plane converge in <60s
- Fallback: route traffic to last-known-good endpoints if convergence fails
- Pager threshold: >3 failed updates in 10m => P1
```

ben_r: Registry client config draft I'm proposing:
```
{"max_retries":4,"base_backoff_ms":300,"max_backoff_ms":8000,"token_refresh_jitter_s":5,"on_429":"exp_backoff_slowdown"}
```

taylor_ops: Quick question: for readonly fallback, do we require offline signature validation? Security asks we validate artifact checksums.

ben_r: Yes, we'll keep signature verification. Fallback only serves artifacts with verified checksum and manifest age < 168h. I'll add this to MLENG-3420.

nina.p: Also adding an operational metric: "registry_auth_429_rate" and "control_plane_update_duration_p95" to the incidents dashboard and the pre-rollout gating page. If either crosses threshold, block rollout.
